items.prompt: Complete the puzzle by filling every place. You have 1 large triangle, 1 medium triangle and 1 parallelogram.
hints: Start with the biggest outline. It needs the large triangle.
Match a long straight edge of a piece to an edge of the outline. Tap Turn if the piece points the wrong way.
The parallelogram can lean left or right. Tap Flip if it leans the wrong way.
items.explanation: The 3 pieces fit together with no gaps: 1 large triangle, 1 medium triangle and 1 parallelogram. Each piece fills one outline exactly.
